items.title: Scripture
items.body: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me. — Revelation 3:20 (KJV)

items.title: Farmer's Almanac tip
items.body: November is a good time to plant trees and shrubs. The cool weather helps roots settle without summer heat stress.

items.title: Joke of the day
items.body: Grandpa's rule for fishing: If you catch one, keep it. If you catch two, tell somebody. If you catch three, tell everybody. If you catch none, blame the moon.
